notes: Original SC TO-I with the Offer to Purchase and Letter of Transmittal (excerpt ends inside the Letter of Transmittal). commencement_date is taken from the date of the Offer to Purchase (June 21, 2021, also the filing date); the excerpt does not use the word 'commence' for this offer. size_shares 36,453,707 is stated in the fee-calculation footnote as 30% of 121,512,358 shares outstanding as of June 15, 2021. trigger_origin: the filing ties the offer to a shareholder-approved proposal (July 9, 2020) requesting a self-tender for at least 40%, following a ~15% tender commenced December 3, 2020; no enum value names a shareholder proposal, so 'other' (could be read as board_discretionary). The offer states it is not conditioned on any minimum number of shares tendered, so minimum_tender is excluded. 'other' in conditions also covers deregistration under the Exchange Act and a forced loan liquidation that would hurt NAV (Section 4(a)(ii) and 4(b)); section 4(d)(v) also lets the Board refuse on any material adverse event in its judgment. Expected Saba-managed tender of ~25.7 million shares is stated but is not a schema field. No results fields: this is the commencement document.
